in_sanskrit.name: Riyan
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who rules, the king.

in_hindi.name: रियान
in_hindi.long_meaning: राजा (rājā) - king, शाही (shāhī) - ruler, वासिले (vāsile) - inhabitant, प्रभावशाली (prabhāvaśālī) - powerful.

in_tamil.name: ரியான்
in_tamil.long_meaning: அரசர் (arasar) - king, கழகம் குழந்தை (kazhagam kuṝṉṟaṟ) - commander, அமைப்பாளர் (amip pāḷar) - ruler, administrator.

in_telugu.name: రిಯన్
in_telugu.long_meaning: జీధేశ (jīdēśa) - king, శహీద (śahīda) - ruler, ప్రభావీశ (prabhāvīśa) - powerful.

in_marathi.name: Rian
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Skies
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rian हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rian is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Riyan', which means 'Lord of the Skies'. This name is associated with the Hindu deity Indra, who is known as the god of thunder, rain, and the sky.
